# chameleon_schedule (Data Source)

Look up a single schedule by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_schedule" "daily_build" {
  id = "2b3a9c41-1d4e-4a5b-b2c3-7d8e9f0a1b2c"
}

output "next_run" {
  value = data.chameleon_schedule.daily_build.next_run_at
}
```
